_what: The one search's settings (do-work/search-everything.mjs). The numbers are old trillion's src/search.json at b6ae0ebf (limit, min_word_length, merge_seconds, moments_per_thing, fusion.k and fusion.word_confidence_floor; place labels for name and written). `lanes` are the engine's two storage reads this tool asks, each with its old lane's place, source and rank: `records` is records:search at @own-records (trillion-rust src/record_value/records-door.json `search`; each record kind it answers is its own lane, rank 1 as the old words-in-records lanes), and `files` is the files' name search at @namespace (src/account_files/account-files-door.json `search`, the old file-names lane, rank 0.8), asked only when no record type narrows the question.
